summary: DMFI PAC (pro-Israel Democratic PAC) endorsed Bale Dalton (FL-07) as a 'pro-Israel Democrat' in its Majority Project, citing his stance on the U.S.-Israel relationship.
quote: DMFI PAC Majority Project announced its general election endorsement of five pro-Israel Democratic candidates for the U.S. House of Representatives… The endorsed candidates are Bale Dalton (FL-07)… focused on helping elect strong, principled pro-Israel Democrats
